desktop.note: Measured in the app at a 1904×874 browser viewport (≈ 1920×1080 screen): 47 × 18 tiles. Laptops of ~1366–1440 px show ~31–33 columns: everything right of the dashed line moves to page 2.

tablet.note: Portrait tablet 744–1023 px wide at a fixed 13 px font (WG_TABLET_CFG): 23–26 × 30–39 tiles; designed on a safe 23 × 30 page. Widgets are packed in priority order: page 1 = what you need at the table, later pages = the rest.

tabIntent.character: The full sheet: who you are, your numbers, and what you can do. Level Up and Rest live here.
tabIntent.social: Talking, bargaining and lying: portrait and info for roleplay, CHA/WIS skills, spells that help in a conversation.
tabIntent.exploring: Travel and searching: the map in the middle, Perception/Survival/Stealth, senses (passive features) and utility spells.
tabIntent.combat: Your turn at a glance: HP and Conditions top-left, Your Turn in the middle, attacks/spells beside it, the shared Initiative Tracker on the right.
tabIntent.inventory: Gear and carrying: Inventory large, equipped weapons in Attacks, STR for carry weight.

gaps: Wild Shape forms: no widget (Io). Now only Resources + Active Features.
Lucky (Luck Points): not in Resources (Addy). Origin feat without a counter.
Social widgets (NPC relations, quests, factions) no longer exist; old dashboards still reference them (npcRelations, quests, factionRenown, background).
Exploring has no Senses widget (darkvision, passive Perception) or travel pace; old dashboards still reference senses/travelPace.
Currency/encumbrance as separate widgets are gone (old types currency, encumbrance, equipment, attunedItems); check whether Inventory shows gold and weight.
Unknown types render as Ability Scores on desktop: Nero's desktop (snapshot 2026-09-26) is full of them; Ren's phone slot too.
Laptop: the desktop slot is one layout for every screen size. Rows below row ~13 get clamped on 1366×768.

characters.name: Ren Ashvane

social.note: Active Features shows Psi-Bolstered Knack and his telepathy; Resources beside it for the Psionic Dice.
